task.description:
Implement SCH-04 (Escalation timer) per docs/requirements/SCH-04.md and the SCH-04 extension in src/design/scheduler.md.

Implementation requirements:
- When EE-03 activates a HUMAN_TASK with escalation_timer_duration, create a durable escalation timer in the same transaction as task creation.
- Represent escalation timers with a payload/contract distinct from the existing timer-node timers, following the design artifact.
- When SCH-02 fires an escalation timer, append an ESCALATION event only if the task is still PENDING.
- If the escalation payload specifies reassignment, perform the task reassignment in the same transaction as the ESCALATION event append.
- When the task completes before escalation fires, cancel the pending escalation timer atomically per SCH-03.
- Preserve race semantics: completion-vs-fire remains first-commit-wins, with the losing transaction rolled back.
- Preserve the pure-function rule in src/engine/transition.zig.
- Keep SQL parameterized and changes focused to SCH-04 scope.

Validation requirements:
- zig build exits 0
- zig build test exits 0
- zig build migrate exits 0
acceptance_criteria: Task activation creates escalation timers atomically with HUMAN_TASK creation when escalation_timer_duration is configured
Scheduler firing appends ESCALATION only while the task remains PENDING
Optional reassignment occurs in the same transaction as ESCALATION event persistence
Task completion cancels pending escalation timers atomically

result.summary: Implemented SCH-04 escalation timers so HUMAN_TASK activation persists distinct escalation timers atomically, scheduler firing appends ESCALATION only while the task remains PENDING, optional reassignment occurs in the same transaction, and task completion cancels pending escalation timers atomically.
